name: VLDBench
description: A comprehensive benchmark for detecting disinformation in both unimodal (text-only) and multimodal (text and image) online news posts, containing 31,000 news article-image pairs across 13 categories with expert annotations.
reputation: A newly proposed multimodal disinformation benchmark that is not yet broadly established as a standard community benchmark.
notes: Includes semi-automated data curation with expert annotation and aligns with AI governance frameworks.
